page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor. The system features 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, supported by a 35 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is weak, with Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core scores falling into the bottom 10% and 25% respectively. However, multi-core performance is average, as demonstrated by the Geekbench multi-core score of 5741.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 13034.32. Memory bandwidth remains average across both small and large block reads, though overall Passmark memory scores are weak.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. It achieves average throughput in static web serving (7.81 GB/sec) and Redis SET operations (11.19 million operations per second), making it suitable for multi-threaded applications, web serving, and moderate database operations. Given its older Intel Xeon architecture, it offers a mature, dedicated hardware profile that is qualitatively cost-effective for parallelized legacy workloads, though it is less suited for single-threaded tasks or memory-intensive databases.
